summary: RELX PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting a series of open-market share repurchases executed through J.P. Morgan Securities plc on the London Stock Exchange. Between April 27 and May 15, 2026, RELX bought back a total of 9,148,450 ordinary shares at volume-weighted average prices ranging from 2,465 to 2,697 pence per share. The repurchased shares are held in treasury. Since January 2, 2026, RELX has purchased 48,282,705 shares. This is a routine capital return program, not an issuer tender offer. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is involved. Watch for ongoing buyback execution and potential impact on share count.
